rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No cross-module sequencing in lecture bodies.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This rule binds lecture-FILE bodies (skills-from-the-frontier.md, the-loop-half-filled-in.md — not in scope for this fire); the rule's own text names the module file as the correct home for module numbering ('bridges, forward-references, module numbering... belong to the module file's ## Next/## Bridge'). earn-the-trust.md IS that correct home — its M4 forward-references (lines 81, 83, 93-97) are in-scope-by-design, not a violation of a rule aimed at a different file type.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide/lecture headers pass the squint test AND the truth clause.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slide's BODY is size-bounded, not just its header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Same scoping as rule 4 — this is a module file, not a lecture; slide-body size for this file's own sections is check_slides.md territory (not in this judge's compendium set), and the embedded lectures carry their own body-size accounting.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body teaches the work; trainer manages the room outside text.
